NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lit needs microphone access so you can send voice messages.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lit needs photo library access so you can choose your profile photos.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Lit needs camera access so you can take a profile photo and verify that the photos are really you.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lit needs your location to show your city and the people near you.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Lit uses motion data to orient the camera correctly while you take a photo and to improve location accuracy.
